test_cases.name: Streaming yields without blocking
test_cases.input_setup: Stream 10 chunks from runtime and sample loop latency between yields
test_cases.expected_result: Chunks yielded progressively; event loop lag <= 50 ms

test_cases.name: Partial chunk reassembly
test_cases.input_setup: Mock split JSON structure delivered across streaming chunk boundary
test_cases.expected_result: Valid JSON parsed without syntax errors
test_cases.evidence: Reassembled split chunks into valid JSON: {'chief_complaint': 'Chest pain', 'history_present_illness': 'Started 2 hours ago'}

test_cases.name: Cancellation mid-stream
test_cases.expected_result: Stream resources closed cleanly; no task-destroyed or unclosed warnings
test_cases.evidence: Consumer exited after 3 chunks; stream aclose() confirmed called

test_cases.name: Empty input handling
test_cases.input_setup: Pass empty string to RefineText and Translate
test_cases.expected_result: Rejects empty input gracefully with clear validation error
test_cases.evidence: RefineText and Translate reject empty input with informative ValueError

test_cases.name: Arabic diacritics preserved
test_cases.input_setup: Input Arabic clinical phrase with full tashkeel diacritics
test_cases.expected_result: Diacritics intact and unchanged throughout text processing
test_cases.evidence: Preserved all tashkeel diacritics in Arabic clinical text: 'المَريضُ يُعَانِي مِنْ ضِيقٍ فِي التَّنَفُّسِ'
